Subject: Re: [ie-rant] Weekend Break

I was thinking somewhere they have trad music and irish dancing, near Waterford, like maybe 2-3 hours drive

Shane Mac Curtain  wrote:                               Are you looking for good hotel or good location?

I find tripadvisor is pretty good in terms of reviews of hotels. The McKennas have their Best of Bridgestone guide up too which gives you some pointers although it is a bit dated.  

Cork is good and the film festival is coming up

Kerry is overpriced in most parts although Jungle republic is back and in Killarney in early November, when I presume hotels should be cheaper.

Limerick has a glut of really good hotels which are competing heavily on price- check tripadvisor. Was getting good four star over the summer for artists we had here for as little as 70 euro per room.  

But then I presume you weren't thinking Limerick :-)





On 10/8/07, Robert Early  wrote:                                   Yep, nowhere I could recommend though.  Whenever I went I was underimpressed and overcharged.  I'm convinced that holidays here are for rich foreign tourists with more money than sense.

R.
